title: A Naturally Derived Glycosylated Oleanolic Acid Derivative Suppresses NF-kappaB Translocation and Induces Intrinsic Apoptosis in Lung Adenocarcinoma Cells.
authors: Pajaniradje, Sankar; Subramanian, Srividya; Mohankumar, Kumaravel; Ronsard, Larance; Anaikutti, Parthiban; Rajagopalan, Rukkumani
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然衍生物F4B1抑制NF-kB转位并诱导肺癌细胞凋亡，虽涉及NF-kB（转录因子）但核心是药物抗癌机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅含简单分子对接，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study investigates the molecular mechanism of action of F4B1, a novel oleanolic acid derivative in human lung adenocarcinoma cells. F4B1 is a naturally occurring oleanolic acid derivative that was isolated and purified from the leaves of Sesbania grandiflora. Structural analyses were carried out using 1D and 2D NMR, FT-IR, and mass spectrometric analyses. MTT assay was employed to evaluate antiproliferative effects in A549 (a model for lung cancer), MCF-7 (a model for breast cancer), HEP-2 (a model for head and neck cancer) and in MRC-5 (human lung fibroblast cells). Fluorescence staining, scanning electron microscopy, and flow cytometry were employed to study apoptosis and cell cycle. Western blotting, RT-PCR, and immunofluorescence techniques were followed to study the mechanisms of cell death. Schrodinger software was employed for docking studies. While preliminary screening was conducted in multiple cell lines, A549 cells were chosen for further mechanistic exploration based on their higher sensitivity to F4B1 treatment. F4B1 blocks the proliferation and causes intrinsic mode of cell death in lung adenocarcinoma cells. In particular, the above anticancer effect was mediated through a mechanism that is associated with the inactivation of NF-kappa B signaling and suppression of cyclin D1 expression leading to cell cycle arrest at the G1/S phase. Our study confirms that F4B1 induces apoptosis, as confirmed through Annexin V staining results. It is intrinsic apoptosis, as evidenced by upregulation of pro-apoptotic markers (BAX), downregulation of anti-apoptotic markers (BCL-2), cytochrome C release, activation of caspase-9, and caspase-3. These results establish the involvement of the mitochondrial-mediated apoptotic pathway. The pathway also involved the suppression of the proto-oncogene c-Myc both at the transcriptional and translational levels. Docking studies show that F4B1 has a high affinity binding towards CXCR4 and SRC kinase. Our findings specifically contribute to understanding the mechanism of F4B1, the isolated molecule from S. grandiflora, as an anticancer drug candidate and will hopefully pave the way toward further studies.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了F4B1（一种新型齐墩果酸衍生物）在人肺腺癌细胞中的作用分子机制。F4B1是一种天然存在的齐墩果酸衍生物，从大花田菁（Sesbania grandiflora）叶片中分离纯化获得。采用一维和二维核磁共振（NMR）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）及质谱分析进行结构表征。通过MTT实验评估了F4B1在A549（肺癌模型）、MCF-7（乳腺癌模型）、HEP-2（头颈癌模型）及MRC-5（人肺成纤维细胞）中的抗增殖效应。采用荧光染色、扫描电子显微镜和流式细胞术研究细胞凋亡和细胞周期。通过蛋白质印迹（Western blotting）、逆转录聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）和免疫荧光技术研究细胞死亡机制。使用Schrodinger软件进行分子对接研究。虽然初步筛选在多种细胞系中进行，但基于A549细胞对F4B1处理具有较高敏感性，选择其进行进一步的机制探索。F4B1阻断肺腺癌细胞增殖并诱导内源性细胞死亡模式。特别地，上述抗癌效应通过一种与NF-kappa B信号失活及细胞周期蛋白D1表达抑制相关的机制介导，导致细胞周期阻滞于G1/S期。我们的研究证实F4B1诱导细胞凋亡，这一点通过Annexin V染色结果得到确认。该凋亡为内源性凋亡，证据包括促凋亡标志物（BAX）上调、抗凋亡标志物（BCL-2）下调、细胞色素C释放、caspase-9和caspase-3激活。这些结果确立了线粒体介导凋亡通路的参与。该通路还涉及原癌基因c-Myc在转录和翻译水平的抑制。对接研究表明，F4B1对CXCR4和SRC激酶具有高亲和力结合。我们的发现具体有助于理解从大花田菁中分离的分子F4B1作为抗癌药物候选物的机制，并有望为后续研究铺平道路。
